children: Hooker rescinded and cancelled excess equity awards previously granted to Jeremy R. Hoff, the company's Chief Executive Officer and Director, to comply with the Stock Incentive Plan annual limit.
Fiscal 2026 awards: rescinded as of Feb 20, 2025; Fiscal 2027 awards: rescinded as of Apr 13, 2026
Awards exceeded the 75,000-share annual limit under the Stock Incentive Plan

Fiscal 2026 awards included 40,383 time-based RSUs, EPS PSUs (max 40,383) and TSR PSUs (max 40,383); Fiscal 2027 awards included 35,656 time-based RSUs, EPS PSUs (max 35,656) and TSR PSUs (max 35,656)

title: Hooker names Jeremy R. Hoff in equity award rescission after plan limit breach
